topics.topic: Overall-progress denominator treatment of planned-work sections without SectionProgress
questions: Is a planned-work section without a SectionProgress record excluded from both numerator and denominator, or does its planned work remain in the denominator under the State 0 weighted-progress rule?
Does the overall-progress denominator include every active-budget section with planned work, or only those having a progress record?
Does a planned-work section without a SectionProgress record remain in the overall-progress denominator, or is it excluded until its first progress update?

quotes:
- `completed_work_total` (here and in `BudgetView`) is the sum of the
  sections' `completed_work_value` that are not `None`; a section without a
  progress record is left out of the sum, as it is left out of overall
  progress (A9).
judgement.divergence: Including every active-budget section with planned work in the denominator yields 50%; excluding the section without a progress record yields 100%; the viewer reading overall progress notices.
judgement.why: The two State 1 passages give different denominator membership for a planned-work section without recorded progress.

bases.rests_on:
Actual materials, remaining materials (overspend shown, not clamped),
completed work value (`planned work cost × completion percent`),
cost-weighted overall progress (arithmetic mean forbidden; unavailable when
no planned work cost exists), payments total, and work balance
(`completed work value − received payments`, shown as
`Completed ahead of payments` or `Unused advance payment`, or as balanced
when it is zero) are always
recomputable from their owning records and are never primary editable state.

bases.passage:
- `completed_work_total` (here and in `BudgetView`) is the sum of the
  sections' `completed_work_value` that are not `None`; a section without a
  progress record is left out of the sum, as it is left out of overall
  progress (A9).

unsupported_sides:
- `completed_work_total` (here and in `BudgetView`) is the sum of the
  sections' `completed_work_value` that are not `None`; a section without a
  progress record is left out of the sum, as it is left out of overall
  progress (A9).

witness.initial: An active budget has sections A and B, each with `work_planned = 100`, and neither has a SectionProgress record.
events: An authorized operator records `completion_percent = 100` for section A.
An authenticated viewer opens the project and reads work progress.
outcomes: Weighting across sections with planned work includes section B's planned work in the denominator and yields `overall_progress_percent = 50`.
Leaving section B out of overall progress excludes it from the denominator and yields `overall_progress_percent = 100`.
witness.observer: The authenticated viewer reading overall project progress.
basis: An authorized operator maintains ordered client-facing Budget Sections with planned material and work amounts.

For an active project an operator can: correct, include, or exclude an expense; allocate or manually split it across sections or `Other expenses` (allocation sum equals the expense total; automatic proportional split is forbidden); update manual work progress per section (0–100%); register work payments (idempotent by stable payment identity); publish progress photos and manage caption, section association, and visibility; maintain the manual budget; review and activate imported budget versions.

An authenticated viewer sees the list of their assigned projects, opens one,
and reads: Registry project context, budget summary with source and ordered
sections, included and excluded confirmed expenses with `Other expenses`
separate, client-visible documents, work progress and completed work value,
payments and work balance, and the chronological photo gallery.

topics.topic: PaymentSummary completed-work total and balance when section progress values are missing
questions: Does PaymentSummaryView use the same sum of non-None section values, and if no section has recorded progress does it return numeric zero and compute a balance, or is the payment summary/balance unavailable?

When one or more planned sections lack progress records, does PaymentSummaryView sum only recorded completed-work values and compute a balance, or is its completed-work total and therefore the payment component unavailable?

When some or all sections have no recorded completed-work value, is PaymentSummaryView required to use the partial/empty sum and calculate a balance, or must the completed-work total and balance be represented as unavailable until the missing progress is recorded?

quotes: build_payment_view: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST project every payment ordered by payment_date descending, then recorded_at descending, then payment_id descending, and derive payments_total plus WorkBalanceResult at read time through _project_payments, from the completed work _project_progress derives.

_project_progress: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] For a section with no progress row, MUST emit completion_percent None and completed_work_value None, and MUST include that section rather than omitting it; completed_work_total is the sum of the completed_work_value amounts that are not None, so a section without progress is left out of the total and its missing value is never presented as zero.
_project_payments: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST project every payment, derive payments_total, preserve completed_work_total, and use calculate_work_balance for balance/label.

calculate_work_balance: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return quantized completed_work_total minus payments_total and the label the sign of that difference selects: WorkBalanceLabel.COMPLETED_AHEAD_OF_PAYMENTS when it is positive, WorkBalanceLabel.UNUSED_ADVANCE_PAYMENT when it is negative, WorkBalanceLabel.BALANCED when it is zero.
judgement.why: State 7 requires PaymentSummaryView to use the completed-work total derived by `_project_progress`, excluding missing section values, and then calculate the numeric balance and label from that total.

topics.topic: ProgressView section inclusion when SectionProgress is missing
questions: Does `list_project_progress` include every qualifying section of the active budget, using null values for sections without SectionProgress, or only sections having a SectionProgress record?

quotes: build_progress_view: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST project active-budget sections, manual completion values, per-section completed work, total, and weighted overall progress. For a section with no progress row, completion_percent and completed_work_value both remain None and MUST NOT be zero-filled, because the absence of a measurement is not a measurement of zero.

_project_progress: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] For a section with no progress row, MUST emit completion_percent None and completed_work_value None, and MUST include that section rather than omitting it; completed_work_total is the sum of the completed_work_value amounts that are not None, so a section without progress is left out of the total and its missing value is never presented as zero.
judgement.why: State 7 explicitly requires every active-budget section to be included, with null progress fields when its SectionProgress row is absent.

topics.topic: ProjectOverview progress availability and value when no SectionProgress exists
questions: What `progress_availability` and `progress` value does ProjectOverview return when an active budget exists but no SectionProgress record has ever been created?

quotes:
`ProgressView`: sections with their percent and completed work (both
absent when no progress is recorded), the completed work total over the
sections with a recorded progress, and the weighted overall percent or
`None`.
`ScopedNotFoundError` when the project has no active version.
judgement.why: State 5 makes absence of an active budget—not absence of SectionProgress—the condition for `not_configured`, so an active budget with no progress records produces an available ProgressView with absent per-section progress values.
